1	# Second Brain
2	
3	AI-powered knowledge management platform combining Obsidian-style document management with Linear-style task management and multi-agent collaboration.
4	
5	## Architecture
6	
7	```
8	second-brain/
9	├── apps/
10	│   ├── api/         # Hono + Cloudflare Workers (D1, R2, AI, Durable Objects)
11	│   ├── web/         # Next.js 15 + Cloudflare Pages
12	│   └── mobile/      # Expo SDK 52 / React Native (iOS + Android)
13	├── docs/            # API spec, deploy guide
14	├── .github/         # CI/CD workflows
15	└── lighthouserc.js  # Lighthouse CI config
16	```
17	
18	### Tech Stack
19	
20	| Layer | Technology |
21	|-------|-----------|
22	| API | Hono on Cloudflare Workers |
23	| Database | Cloudflare D1 (SQLite) + FTS5 full-text search |
24	| Object Storage | Cloudflare R2 (Markdown, images) |
25	| AI | Cloudflare Workers AI (embeddings, summarization) |
26	| Realtime | Durable Objects (WebSocket collaboration) |
27	| Web Frontend | Next.js 15, React 18, CodeMirror 6, React Flow |
28	| Mobile | Expo SDK 52 / React Native 0.76 |
29	| Auth | GitHub OAuth + session-based |
30	| Monitoring | Sentry (client), Lighthouse CI |
31	| CI/CD | GitHub Actions (build, test, E2E, Lighthouse) |
32	
33	## Features
34	
35	### Core
36	- **Documents** -- Markdown editor, revisions, wikilinks, tags, folders
37	- **Tasks** -- Kanban board, priorities, assignments, dependencies
38	- **Search** -- FTS5 full-text + AI semantic search
39	- **Graph** -- Knowledge graph visualization (React Flow)
40	- **Timeline** -- Unified activity feed
41	
42	### AI & Agents
43	- 7-agent team with task assignment and progress tracking
44	- AI-powered auto-summarization
45	- Semantic search with vector embeddings
46	- AI apply (content transformation)
47	
48	### Collaboration
49	- Real-time collaborative editing via WebSocket (Durable Objects)
50	- Comments with @mention notifications
51	- Emoji reactions on documents
52	- Public note sharing via tokens
53	- Team workspaces with role-based permissions (owner/admin/member)
54	
55	### Security
56	- GitHub OAuth authentication
57	- TOTP two-factor authentication
58	- User-issued API keys (read/write/admin scopes)
59	- Rate limiting (read: 120/min, mutation: 40/min)
60	- Webhook integrations with HMAC signing
61	
62	### Mobile (Expo)
63	- GitHub OAuth login via AuthSession + SecureStore
64	- Offline-first with AsyncStorage + pending edits queue
65	- Background sync with conflict resolution (last-write-wins)
66	- Push notifications via Expo Push API
67	- Full-text search
68	- Dark mode support
69	- EAS Build profiles (development/preview/production)
70	
71	### Quality & Infrastructure
72	- PWA support (manifest, service worker)
73	- PDF export (print-optimized CSS)
74	- Obsidian vault / Notion JSON import
75	- Weekly digest email (cron)
76	- Lighthouse CI (score 90+ targets)
77	- Playwright E2E tests (auth, CRUD, collab, sharing, accessibility)
78	- Sentry error monitoring (client-side)
79	- WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility (skip links, ARIA, focus management, contrast)
80

82	
83	```bash
84	# Prerequisites: Node.js 20+, pnpm 9+
85	pnpm install
86

88	pnpm dev
89

91	pnpm test           # Unit tests (Vitest)
92	pnpm test:e2e       # E2E tests (Playwright)

115	- `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE` -- API base URL (defaults to production)

# Decision - Second Brain Primary

Date: 2026-06-05
Asked by: Yakonさん
Context: Obsidian連携によるShiroの第二の脳構築中に、既存Second Brainアプリへ寄せる選択肢が出た

## Question

Obsidianを主系にするか、Second Brainアプリが機能するならSecond Brain側へ寄せるか。

## Decision

Second Brainアプリがうまく機能するなら、主系はSecond Brainへ寄せる。Obsidian vaultはMarkdown保険・移植元・バックアップ知識層として維持する。

## Criteria

- Second BrainはUI、検索、タスク、エージェント運用まで統合できる
- Obsidianは人間可読なMarkdownとして残す用途に強い
- 将来の自動化やRAGはSecond Brain側に寄せた方が運用価値が高い
- Markdown vaultを残せば、Second Brain側が不安定でもデータ可搬性を保てる

Date: 2026-06-05

Owner: Shiro

## What Happened

`second-brain/` をObsidian vaultルートとして扱い、既存プロジェクトの `README.md` を一時的にvault READMEで上書きした。

## Why It Happened

`second-brain/` が既存Gitプロジェクトであることを確認する前に、vaultルートとして使えると判断した。

## Prevention

- vault配置を決める前に、対象ディレクトリが既存Gitプロジェクトか確認する
- 既存プロジェクト配下に置く場合は `obsidian-vault/` のような専用サブディレクトリに分離する
- 既存ファイル名と衝突する `README.md` などは先に存在確認する
